grid.note: calibration from the bolt-hole grid (20 cm, from the handout); dot sizes are for photos ~1280 px wide; tolerance and reach are in grid cells

detection.note: everything the real wall photos use besides the sweep's grid and real_wall_algorithm.json. Photos are resized to px_per_m (a typical 12 cm hold is then 13 px, which suits the superpixel sizes, window and kernel in pixels); real_shape = size/shape limits of a hold in metres; labels_wall = the photo whose holds are hand-labelled (the sweep tunes on it), test_wall = the photo the chosen settings are tested on
